extracted.name: Bread Recipe
extracted.description: “There is nothing more beautiful than the aroma of fresh bread at dawn.” 🌿🍞✨
ingredient_lines: 4 cups all-purpose flour • 1 tbsp instant yeast • 3 tbsp powdered milk • ½ tbsp sugar • ½ tbsp salt • 1 egg 🥚 • 2 cups water 💧
instruction_lines: 1. 🥣 Mix all dry ingredients together. 2. In a bowl, whisk 1 ½ cups of water with the egg until well combined. 3. Add the dry mixture and knead well. 4. If needed, add the remaining ½ cup of water gradually until the dough becomes soft and smooth.

5. Cover and let the dough rise until it doubles in size ⏳. 6. Divide, shape into molds or rolls, and let rise again. 7. 🔥 Bake in a preheated oven until golden brown and fully baked. ✨ Enjoy your homemade fresh bread! ✨
